Rendering: Surface-owned renderer and scheduler
|-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) [src/renderer/generic.zig]
|   |-- terminal_state: terminal.RenderState - derived snapshot
|   |-- font_shaper / shaping cache / image state / GPU frame resources
|   |-- font_grid reference -> App.font_grid_set (Surface holds grid reference)
|   |-- GraphicsAPI: compile-time Metal or OpenGL; borrows App.device
|   |-- updateFrame(Surface.renderer_state)
|   |   |-- lockDemand: read shared Terminal, viewport, dirty flags
|   |   |-- terminal_state.beginUpdate; copy preedit / mouse / image inputs
|   |   |-- unlockDemand; terminal_state.endUpdate outside shared lock
|   |   `-- Snapshot + font grid + shaper -> glyphs / atlas-backed cells
|   |       `-- Selection, cursor, preedit and Kitty placements contribute to frame
|   `-- drawFrame -> graphics API -> host surface presentation
|       `-- Surface.draw can call drawFrame(true) on the main thread
`-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread [src/renderer/Thread.zig] - sibling of renderer
    |-- Owns mailbox / wakeup / timers; borrows renderer and shared State
    |-- I/O output wakeup -> updateFrame / drawFrame scheduling
    `-- .resize from Surface AND Termio -> display geometry update
